what: A thin progress line fills 0→100% in a straight line over (number of sections × 5 seconds), and the lit cell changes each time it passes an equal share per section (a count like ‹2 : 4› follows too), when full, it starts over from the beginning. Hovering a cell makes the line jump to that cell’s position and keep filling from there, and on phones (no hover) each press on the panel jumps to the next cell. Unlit cells recede to .1 (0 on phones) and their description text hides — .3s expo-out. Only the lit cell’s video plays

options.each: Time spent on one cell (sec), default 5
options.--fx-off: Opacity of off cells (style), default .1 — always 0 on phones (cells overlap in one spot)
options.--fx-dur: Cell fade out and fade in duration (style), default .3s
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Line to fill up (child, required) — scaleX with the left as the axis
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cell (child, two or more required). Inside, [data-fx-part=more] is a description shown only in the active slot, video plays only in the active slot
options.[data-fx-part=now]·[data-fx-part=total]: Current slide number and total count (optional)
options.stack: ”true” overlaps the cells in one place even on wide screens (phone style). Without it, cells line up horizontally at 1024 and up.
